exposure: Genetic subtype (deletions, uniparental disomy, imprinting defects, other or unknown subtypes)
finding: Japanese patients with PWS had higher rates of assisted reproductive technology use in mothers, polyhydramnios, decreased fetal movements, cesarean section, hypotonia, feeding difficulties, and undescended testis.
mod_finding: A total of 60.5% of patients were born by cesarean section.
